;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]] and [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] says that hundreds of rebels stormed [[Syrian Army]] positions in [[Idlib Governorate]], the ensuing fighting left 50 rebels dead and 90 wounded while government forces reported 40 dead and 80 wounded. A military source cited by Syrian state news agency [[Syrian Arab News Agency|SANA]] says the [[Al-Nusra Front|Jabhat al-Nusra]] terrorists used various weapons such as [[car bomb]]s, under an "intensive [[suppressive fire|fire cover]]". [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/01/23/Up-to-40-Syrian-Soldiers-killed-80-wounded-in-Idlib-attack-IFAX-.html (Reuters via Al Arabiya)] [https://sana.sy/en/?p=183197 (SANA)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-51221225 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*The ''[[Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists]]'' advances the [[Doomsday Clock]] to 100 seconds before midnight, citing the threats to human survival posed by [[nuclear proliferation]], [[climate change]] and "cyber-based disinformation." This is the closest to midnight that the clock has been since the project began in 1947. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-51213185 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Malaysia]]n agriculture giant [[FGV Holdings Berhad]] announces it will increase its sugar imports from [[India]] from 88,000 tonnes to 133,000 in an attempt to resolve the [[palm oil]] trade dispute between the two nations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-malaysia-exclusive/exclusive-malaysia-to-buy-more-indian-sugar-to-resolve-palm-oil-spat-sources-idUSKBN1ZM0E8 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019–20 Australian bushfire season]]
**A [[C-130]] [[water bomber]] crashes in southern [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]], while helping control a [[bushfire]]. Three [[Americans|American]] [[firefighter]]s are killed. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-01-23/nsw-rfs-air-tanker-crashes-near-numeralla-bushfire/11893554 (ABC News)]

*[[2020 Villa El Salvador explosion]]
**34 people are killed and 28 others are injured after a truck transporting [[liquefied petroleum gas]] caused a gas leak that triggered an explosion in [[Villa El Salvador]], [[Lima metropolitan area]], [[Peru]]. [https://rpp.pe/lima/actualidad/ves-imagenes-de-la-explosion-de-un-camion-cisterna-en-villa-el-salvador-fotos-noticia-1241259 (RPP News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The death toll from the new [[coronavirus]] rises to 25 and 830 confirmed cases in [[China]] as four more Chinese cities, [[Huanggang]], [[Ezhou]], [[Chibi, Hubei|Chibi]] and [[Zhijiang, Hubei|Zhijiang]] are to be placed under [[quarantine]]. The total number of people under quarantine is now over 20 million people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-51230011 (BBC News)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/china-wuhan-coronavirus-quarantine-extended-cities-cut-off-2020-1?r=US&IR=T (''Business Insider'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
***[[Singapore]] confirms its first case of new coronavirus, a 66-year-old Chinese man from [[Wuhan]] who was travelling with his family. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/wuhan-virus-pneumonia-singapore-confirms-first-case-12312860 (Channel NewsAsia)]

;International relations
* Heads of state and dignitaries from around the world attend the fifth [[World Holocaust Forum]] at [[Yad Vashem]] in Jerusalem to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the liberation of the [[Auschwitz extermination camp]] and to address the resurgence of [[antisemitism]] worldwide. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/world-leaders-convene-in-jerusalem-to-remember-holocaust-and-counter-anti-semitism/2020/01/23/e82fa964-3d56-11ea-afe2-090eb37b60b1_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime 
*The [[International Court of Justice]] orders [[Myanmar]] to protect the [[Rohingya]] population from atrocities. [[The Gambia]] had brought a lawsuit before the court over charges of [[genocide]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-world-court/world-court-orders-myanmar-to-protect-rohingya-from-acts-of-genocide-idUSKBN1ZM00H (Reuters)]
*A judicial source close to former [[Nissan]] chairman [[Carlos Ghosn]] says that [[Lebanon]] and [[Japan]] will have 40 days to decide whether he will be extradited back to Japan or stand trial in Lebanon. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/01/23/Lebanon-Japan-have-40-days-to-agree-on-fate-of-ex-Nissan-boss-Ghosn.html (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[European Union (Withdrawal Agreement) Act 2020]] is given [[royal assent]] in the [[United Kingdom]], formally making the bill law. [https://www.vox.com/world/2020/1/23/21070594/brexit-royal-assent-january-31-uk-eu-trade (Vox)]
